scripts.stage: npm run build:vendor && node scripts/stage-hosting.cjs customer-app && node scripts/stage-hosting.cjs artisan-app
scripts.deploy: npm run build:vendor && npm run lint:filters && npm run stage && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:ca: npm run build:vendor && npm run lint:filters && node scripts/stage-hosting.cjs customer-app && firebase deploy --only hosting:customer --project production
scripts.deploy:aa: npm run build:vendor && npm run lint:filters && node scripts/stage-hosting.cjs artisan-app && firebase deploy --only hosting:artisan
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:vendor && npm run lint:filters && node scripts/stage-hosting.cjs admin-dashboard && firebase deploy --only hosting:admin
scripts.deploy:all: npm run lint:filters && npm run stage && firebase deploy
scripts.lint: npm run lint:syntax && npm run lint:filters && npm run lint:tokens && npm run lint:status && npm run lint:instant && npm run lint:shared
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:settings-overlays && npm run test:transaction-receipt && npm run test:topup-charge && npm run test:escrow-auth && npm run test:artisan-privacy && npm run test:emergency-pricing && npm run test:booking-truth && npm run test:complete-booking && npm run test:booking-router && npm run test:booking-actions && npm run test:booking-tracks && npm run test:booking-schedule && python tests/verify_low_fixes.py
scripts.test:lifecycle: npm run test:triggers && npm run test:escrow-e2e && npm run test:authz && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:messaging-e2e && npm run test:quote-e2e
scripts.cap:build: node scripts/build-capacitor.cjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:apk: npm run cap:build && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
